items: START WORKING IMMEDIATELY with a full 1-Year Office 365 Subscription - pre-installed on this versatile 2-in-1 device. Seamlessly switch between laptop and tablet modes using the magnetic keyboard, perfect for writing reports, editing presentations, or online collaboration in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Teams - whether you're a student, remote worker, or creative professional

INSTANTLY TRANSFORM YOUR WORK AND ENTERTAINMENT with this 12-inch 2-in-1 tablet laptop. The included magnetic keyboard snaps on for a full laptop experience to tackle office tasks or studies, then easily use the leather case stand for hands-free movie streaming or following recipes. It's the adaptable tech solution for students, remote workers, and creatives on the go

SEE EVERY DETAIL IN STUNNING CLARITY ON THE VIBRANT 12-INCH 2K IPS TOUCHSCREEN. With true-to-life color accuracy (100% sRGB) perfect for photo editing or design, and 10-point responsive touch for fluid sketching or note-taking, it’s the ideal display for digital artists, students highlighting slides, and professionals presenting interactive reports

EXPERIENCE EFFORTLESS SPEED AND ABUNDANT SPACE WITH 12GB OF RAM AND A 512GB SSD. Multitask seamlessly between creative apps, music streaming, and games, or store your entire media library and project files - all with quick access and no lag, letting you focus on creating, studying, or working without slowdowns

GET POWERFUL PERFORMANCE ON THE GO with the efficient Intel Pentium Gold 6500Y processor. Handle video calls, documents, and multiple apps at once - perfect for smooth Zoom meetings while editing, seamless virtual classes, or creative work - all thanks to 4-thread processing and intelligent 3.4GHz boost speed in this ultra-portable 2-in-1 laptop

EXPERIENCE UNMATCHED PORTABILITY with an ultra-slim 0.36-inch, 1.32-pound 2-in-1 that fits anywhere. Effortlessly switch from sketching in a cafe to productivity on a plane, carrying full Windows power in your bag for instant workflows and video calls wherever you work

NEVER MISS A BEAT WITH SEAMLESS CONNECTIVITY. Reliable dual-band Wi-Fi keeps your video calls and online classes stable at home, school, or the office, while Bluetooth 5.0 allows instant, clear pairing with headphones, mice, and other accessories - all working smoothly together

SIMPLIFY YOUR SETUP WITH VERSATILE USB-C THAT DOES IT ALL - transfer files, charge quickly, and output 4K video with a single cable. Plus, get dock-level expandability with two USB-C ports, Micro HDMI, a power input, and a headphone jack to connect monitors, drives, and accessories effortlessly

WORK WITH ENHANCED EFFICIENCY on the pre-installed Windows 11 Home. It’s designed for stability whether you’re hosting crisp video calls, coding, managing a small business, OpenClaw deployment or seamlessly switching between creative apps and virtual lectures - all on a familiar, professional platform
